title: Marguerite and the Postcard
author: Xanthe Crane
blurb: Tamsin Nystrom, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
